worldCoordinateSystem.note: Physical XYZ is calculated from each feature surface plane by projective homography. Screen GeoJSON geometry is retained for pixel-perfect SVG editing.

depthSpecification.note: This is not physical room Z. Physical X/Y/Z feet are stored in feature properties.worldCoordinatesFt.

shellGeometry.edgePolicy: adjacent room surfaces share identical anchor coordinates at every seam

semanticOverrides.door: Double French door assembly: 2 door leaves, 8 total glass panes, 2 handles mounted on the inner meeting frame rather than on glass.
semanticOverrides.aquarium: Built-in left-wall aquarium with a matching room-extension face, bottom face, and four exact corner-to-corner five-point editable connector LineStrings.
semanticOverrides.weather: A full-stage iframe sits behind all room geometry for weather videos/scenes.
semanticOverrides.pictures: Four picture iframes sit inside their frames; clicking requests an image from the device.

assemblies: double French door→2 door leaves + inner frame→8 glass panes + 2 handles
each picture frame→1 click-to-load image iframe
aquarium-built-in→room extension + bottom face + 4 five-point corner connectors
each wall→its finish bands and attached fixtures

mergeStrategy.shellWindowsDoorAquariumPicturesAC: perspective map geometry retained and cleaned
mergeStrategy.wallFinishBands: physical bubble/wainscot geometry projected onto perspective wall planes
mergeStrategy.colors: new defaults matched to the supplied living-room reference image
mergeStrategy.duplicates: perspective-map versions preferred over duplicate physical-map fixtures

coordinate_collision_contract.object_placement: use world-foot bounds first; editor projection is display only

outside_weather.visibility: through mapped window and French-door glass openings

bed_onyx_state_swap.swap_behavior: replace visual child/state in-place; preserve purchased bed identity, transform, customization, price/source metadata, and collision footprint

rules.translate: apply identical dx/dy/dz to every member of the selected movement group
rules.rotateScale: apply around root transform origin unless child explicitly overrides
rules.vertexEdit: only edited feature vertex changes, except hard endpoint anchors and shared shell anchors
